name: search-index-reindex-p2
prompt: what is the safe way to rebuild my search index without users seeing missing or stale results

chunks.content: decided to build the new index under a fresh name and flip a read alias over to it atomically once the rebuild finishes, so queries never hit a half-populated index
the search box now shows an autocomplete dropdown after the user types two characters
a background job walks every product row and feeds documents into the freshly created index before we promote it
a nightly cron deletes soft-deleted rows older than 90 days
the bulk import tool validates each CSV row and reports the line numbers that failed
persist the user's dark-mode choice in local storage and apply it before first paint
added a read replica for the reporting queries so they stop competing with checkout traffic
while the rebuild runs, live edits are written to both the old and the new index so the new one is not stale when we cut over
the readiness probe waits for the cache to warm before reporting healthy
generate three thumbnail sizes on upload and store them in object storage
publish request duration percentiles to the metrics endpoint every fifteen seconds
narrowed the OAuth scopes requested at consent to just profile and email
render monthly invoices as PDFs in a worker and attach them to the billing email
track how many documents have been indexed versus the total so we only flip the alias once coverage reaches 100 percent
the query parser lowercases terms and strips accents so a search for cafe also finds café
